parsed.notes:
Applied AI, Software Engineering, and Customer Engineering are subsections of Preferred Qualifications; their items remain optional.
Alternatives in qualification lists are labeled individually, including the software engineering, machine learning, and applied AI experience alternatives.
Literal reading: generic retrieval systems do not establish RAG, and semantic search does not necessarily establish vector search; both remain unmapped rather than adding those mappings.
Claude is not explicitly Claude Enterprise or the Anthropic API, so it remains unmapped.
Generic reasoning, planning, model optimization, and foundation models are not narrowed to chain-of-thought, inference optimization, or LLMs.
Memory and tool use are interpreted in their explicitly agentic context.
Technologies and practices named only in responsibilities or descriptions of future learning are excluded.
The 4+ years requirement supports inferred mid seniority; leading customer workshops is not treated as a separate senior-level leadership duty.
